{{Quote|Glad to share my skills with someone talented.|Darb Misken|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Darb Misken''' was<ref name="TOR" /> a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi instructor|Jedi combat instructor]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A dark-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]] with [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], Misken carried a single [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and wore white [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] while stationed in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military's]] [[Aurek Base]], on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darb Misken first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], as a trainer for the Jedi Knight class on the planet Hoth.<ref name="TOR" />
